creators: Thanks to members of the Lucet Lab—Andrew Thompson, Emily Park, Isabelle Lucet, Junqi Pan, and Lyn Deng—for testing and feedback.
description:
A robust, scalable pipeline to run Boltz-2 (https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz) structure predictions with advanced complex modeling, ligand support, and structural constraints, with local multiple sequence alignment (MSA) using Nextflow. nf-boltz-2 orchestrates Boltz structure prediction, handling input preparation, resource management, sequences/ligands complexity, and advanced configuration for constraints and templates. This pipeline runs every step in an Apptainer/Singularity container. 
* Fast setup of complex protein, DNA, and RNA systems.
* Simple parameter specification; flexible for power users via "extra" fields.
* Supports ligands (by CCD or SMILES), pockets, contacts, templates, and batch runs.
name: nf-boltz-2
